title: jurinea chondrilloides
intro: Jurinea chondrilloides, commonly known as Mountain Heliotrope, is a plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including treating digestive issues, such as bloating, and its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Jurinea chondrilloides include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity. Its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
